people.name: Paul Christopher Ohanian
people.title_or_status: FOUNDER, CHIEF COMPLIANCE OFFICER, CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER
people.bio_note: Paul Ohanian has led financial strategies for over 30 years, beginning his career as a CPA before founding Scottsdale Wealth Planning; holds a B.S. in Accounting from Southern Illinois University, Carbondale; is a CFP, CPA (inactive), and holds Series 3, 4, 63, 65, and 66 licenses plus an insurance license; his commentary has appeared in the Arizona Republic, Smart Money, and CNBC, and he contributes to the Arizona Journal of Business and Real Estate on REITs and global markets.
people.bio_source: Firm site (scottsdalewealthplanning.com/our-team/); independent corroboration found via the firm's own Facebook post referencing a published article ('SWP CEO Paul Ohanian on Building Wealth Through Real Estate Investment') and third-party advisor directories (U.S. News money.usnews.com/financial-advisors/advisor/paul-ohanian-1403229, SmartAdvisorMatch, LinkedIn) confirming his CFP credential and role. Could not independently pull the underlying Arizona Republic/Smart Money/CNBC articles themselves (behind paywalls/not indexed) to confirm exact quotes — the specific media-mentions claim remains sourced to the firm's own site and secondary aggregator listings, not a directly verified independent article.

firm_note.text: Scottsdale Wealth Planning was founded and is led by Paul Ohanian, who has served as Founder, CEO, and Chief Compliance Officer since establishing the firm; he personally directs the firm's investment strategies as chair of the SWP Investment Committee.
